title: InternetDiscoveryResponse
description: What the operator's URL answers `internet on --discover`, with status 200. Any other status, or an empty body, means it has no relay for this PC, and `internet on` fails with nothing changed. A flag given at the PC (--token, --login) wins over the answer. The PC keeps what it got in internet.json and does not ask again until the next `internet on --discover`.

relay.description: Where PCs dial in: HOST:PORT of the relay, such as relay.example.com:7000.

token.description: The relay's token (`relay --token-file`), when it asks for one.

login.description: ID:PASSWORD the operator chose for this PC: the proxy login its tasks will use. Without it the PC makes its own, and the operator gets it from the person (`internet credentials`).
